clips.title: The story
paras: Sishir Canyon is a rugged gorge in the Stonetalon Mountains, carving an eastward path through the craggy heights. Thickly swarmed by monstrous Deepmoss spiders and choked in webbing, it serves as the dangerous approach to the Ruins of Eldre'thar. Travelers who brave its tangled depths must contend with venomous arachnids and their brooding matriarch.

Branching off the mountain roads of the Stonetalon range, Sishir Canyon is a treacherous natural corridor cutting toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar. Rather than a quiet mountain trail, the gorge has been thoroughly overrun by Deepmoss spiders. Their sticky silken sheets and clusters of egg sacs smother the stony ground and rock walls, transforming the ravine into a living nest. Travelers and sentinels seeking the night elven ruins beyond must cut their way through swarms of aggressive webspinners.
